reading: Christiane Amanpour, a chief international anchor, has announced she will separate from her organisation next year after more than four decades.
In a recent statement, the broadcaster explained that she made this difficult decision after many months of careful thought.
She began her career there in 1983 and eventually became one of their best-known correspondents.
Over the years, she has frequently reported on dangerous conflicts around the world.
She has presented her own nightly interview program on international television since 2009.
Amanpour expressed deep gratitude to the amazingly talented teams and field crews who shared her incredible journey.
The chairman of the company described her as a highly trusted professional.
She praised her teams because they battled together to seek the facts and broadcast the truth.

vocabulary.definition: A person who presents and coordinates a television or radio program.
An official or formal report that shares facts or opinions.
A choice or judgment that you make after thinking carefully.
Reporters who provide news from a particular area or on a specific subject.
Long periods of active fighting or wars between groups or countries.
The feeling of being thankful and wanting to show appreciation.
To send out programs or information by television or radio.
